issues.issue: Cacao and Lapte are independently familiar ingredients; their actual displayed descriptions are accurate. Both intermediate definitions were read: Înghețată allows milk or water bases, while Chec explicitly permits plain/cocoa/fruit variants. Current producer Ciao Amore lists cocoa and milk in a chocolate ice cream; original e-Retete 2009 independently documents the same ingredient association across time. The latter recipe includes rum, but no alcohol-dependent association, wording or play value is imported; the producer example supplies the same route without it. Laura Laurentiu directly recommends cake alongside milk and offers a cocoa version. That proves Chec→Lapte as serving together, not a silently changed ingredient assertion. Dairy-free ice cream and non-cocoa cakes do not invalidate qualified variants. Root is independently reviewing proposed earned captions; this factual review does not claim those drafts already display. Final BFF replay must inspect actual captions after their freeze.
